authoring.note: The Garrison's own supply counter: personnel kit issued against a docket, signed for, and gone again inside a minute. Nobu runs it alone at a pace that should be impossible and somehow isn't -- every candidate leaves kitted, logged, and one item richer than their budget said they should be.

lore.playerFacing: A long counter backed by shelving that runs floor to ceiling, everything labelled, nothing decorative. The room smells of machine oil and stamped paperwork, and it is never quiet -- a radio somewhere behind the shelving, a phone that rings and gets answered mid-sentence, a man talking to three people at once and somehow finishing every conversation. Whatever's on the docket is on the counter before the door's finished swinging shut.
lore.gmOnly:
This is Kit Issue's real location -- see data/scene-briefs/episode-c1e1--kit-issue.json for the full scripted beat and data/npcs/nobu.json / ideas/story/bible/characters/nobu.md for his voice and the material that must never be played early. Outside that scripted scene, treat the stores as the standing answer to 'where does personnel equipment come from' -- a resupply, an exchange, a lost-kit replacement can all be run here on the same register: fast, functional, Nobu mid-sentence throughout.

If a scene here ever needs tension, find it somewhere other than Nobu's manner -- he is never the source of unease.

hooks: A candidate corners Nobu after hours hoping for a second of his undivided attention, and gets exactly the same fast, warm thirty seconds everyone else does -- which lands as reassuring to some and as a small, specific disappointment to others.

The queue backs up past the door on a day the Garrison's short-staffed, and whoever's waiting has time to actually look at the shelves instead of the counter -- and the shelves say more about what this base expects to need than the catalogue does.
activities: Draw or exchange personnel equipment against a standing docket.
Report lost or damaged kit and get it replaced -- no questions beyond the paperwork.
Catch Nobu between three conversations for thirty seconds of his actual, undivided attention.
